job.job_description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer with strong expertise in Python/Django and solid engineering fundamentals. You will design and build scalable backend systems, integrate diverse platforms, and ensure our products are reliable, performant, and future ready.


Responsibilities:


Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs.
Lead system integrations with third-party APIs, internal services, and external platforms.
Apply strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and distributed systems to solve complex problems.
Optimize databases and ensure data integrity, scalability, and performance.
Collaborate with product and frontend teams to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.


Required Skills :


Strong experience in Python (Django / FastAPI).
Solid grasp of Computer Science fundamentals: Data structures, algorithms, system design, scalability, networking basics.
Experience with APIs and system integrations (REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, third-party services).
Hands-on with databases and cloud platforms.
Strong debugging, optimization, and problem-solving skills.




Where You ll Work:
Hybrid role based out of Indore.
Primarily WFH, with office visits as per team requirements.


Ideal Candidate Profile:
1 3 years of hands-on experience in backend development, with a proven track record of delivering scalable applications.
Strong foundation in backend concepts, system design, and cloud deployment.
Hands-on experience across the complete product development lifecycle.
Ability to contribute individually as well as mentor and guide team members.
Clear, structured, and confident communication style.


Perks & Benefits:
Hybrid work culture with flexibility & growth opportunities.
Collaborate with a skilled, forward-thinking team
